title: Fix Pinata directory upload, enforce lock→generate gating, and add premium mirror/gloss hero text effect

requirements.summary: Correct Pinata directory upload to wrap files as a directory and surface actionable HTTP status + response details on failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Uploading a generated collection’s images as a directory to Pinata succeeds and returns a directory CID under normal conditions (valid JWT, network available).
When Pinata returns a non-2xx response, the UI shows a failure state and includes the HTTP status plus any response body text/json provided by Pinata (no silent/opaque 400 errors).
The IPFS publishing flow in the Vault completes the image directory upload step without triggering “Directory upload failed: 400” for valid inputs.

file_operations.description: Fix uploadDirectoryToPinata to correctly wrap multiple files as a directory (Pinata wrap-with-directory behavior and directory-style filenames), and improve error handling to include HTTP status plus response body (text and/or parsed JSON) when non-2xx responses occur.

Ensure the IPFS publishing flow propagates enhanced Pinata directory upload failure details returned by uploadDirectoryToPinata so the Vault UI can display actionable status/body info when uploads fail.

Update failure-state UI messaging/toasts for IPFS publishing to include the improved Pinata directory upload error details (HTTP status + response body) rather than opaque “Directory upload failed: 400”.

requirements.summary: Gate all generation/regeneration actions behind the collection lock state by disabling Generate while locked and blocking any alternate generation paths with a clear message.
acceptanceCriteria: When `project.collectionLocked` is true, the Generate button/control is disabled and cannot be triggered via click or keyboard.
When the collection is unlocked, the Generate button/control becomes enabled again (subject to any existing non-lock validation like required layers/traits).
If a user attempts to trigger generation while locked (e.g., via any other UI path), the app prevents it and shows a clear toast/message indicating the collection is locked.

file_operations.description: Disable the primary Generate control when project.collectionLocked is true, and add lock checks to prevent generation from starting via any non-button path (e.g., keyboard handlers, helper functions). Show a clear toast/message when blocked due to lock.

Align lock/unlock messaging and state transitions with generation gating expectations (e.g., ensure unlock clearly restores ability to generate, and lock messaging reinforces that generation is blocked while locked).

requirements.summary: Add a premium interactive mirror/gloss reflection effect to the Dashboard hero text “GENESIS.ENGINE” that preserves existing colors and smoothly follows horizontal mouse movement.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Dashboard page hero heading, a subtle reflective highlight sweeps/follows the cursor horizontally across “GENESIS.ENGINE”.
The base text colors remain unchanged (current foreground + muted “.ENGINE” treatment remains visually consistent).
The reflection uses a gradient mask (light to transparent) rather than outer glows, and remains calm/premium (no neon/glow bloom).
Motion feels smooth and responsive and does not noticeably degrade scrolling or interaction performance on the Dashboard page.

file_operations.description: Create a lightweight Dashboard-only hero text component that renders “GENESIS.ENGINE” with a subtle glass/mirror shine overlay driven by pointer position (horizontal tracking), using requestAnimationFrame-throttled updates for smooth performance.
Wire the new GlossyHeroText component into the existing hero heading area in place of the static “GENESIS.ENGINE” markup, preserving the current base text colors and “.ENGINE” muted treatment.
Add the CSS needed for the mirror/gloss effect (gradient-masked shine overlay, calm opacity, and CSS variables for shine position/intensity) without introducing heavy glow/neon visuals.
